A0164.title: Multi-Chain Asset Mapping and Tracking
A0164.definition: Establish cross-chain asset mapping relationships to track the flow of assets across different blockchains.
A0164.description: Tracking framework: on-chain mapping table; cross-chain indexing; asset fingerprinting; flow path; aggregate monitoring; anomaly alerting; forensic support.
A0164.limitation: Cross-chain data integration is difficult, privacy coins are hard to track, and delayed integration of new chains leads to underreporting. Malicious actors can use cross-chain bridges for mixing and privacy protocols to obfuscate flow paths, bypassing tracking, while legitimate cross-chain swaps and aggregator trades are prone to false positive anomaly alerts.
